description: Schedule products (comma-separated identifiers) for automatic price re-checks hourly, daily or weekly, optionally at one retailer, so later product_offers and product_price_history calls return fresher prices. Requires a Data API key: schedules belong to the key's account (see scheduled_products_list). Scheduled re-checks run on that cadence for retailers ShopSavvy can re-check through an official retailer API; other retailers update as ShopSavvy sees them. 1 credit per product scheduled.

retailer.description: Optional: specific retailer domain to monitor

name: product_schedule
title: Schedule price re-checks
